title: objectui Import Wizard: an import undo that leaves rows unreverted (`success: false` with `failures`, after #24380) shows no message, and the job is still listed as undoable
body:
Unblocked: #12971 closed `completed` when PR #13043 merged as `8aa8e3e1e5` (objectui's pin is now objectstack `main` `f4755a68a797`); re-derived with no new blocker (unlock comment below).

Filing gate ①, class (a): a public door's answer is dropped by its UI consumer. The UI shows nothing where the server reports a refusal. `reach:` every console user whose import undo a control refuses for some rows, once PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24431 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24380) lands. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6024) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01SYEJqDL3NXxrJRBVqaMu9T`, from objectstack-ai/objectstack#24380's dev report (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24431, Acceptance notes). The seat checked both sides in code. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, grade and `repo:*` are triage's. The fix lands in objectstack-ai/objectui.

## What the server answers (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24431, ruling `6257104178` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24380)

`POST /api/v1/data/import/jobs/:jobId/undo` runs its reversal writes under the object's declared controls for every caller but the system principal. A row a control refuses is not reverted. The answer is a `200` with `success: false`, `failed: N` and a `failures` array of `{ id, action, code, error }` per unreverted row (`UndoImportJobResponseSchema` in `@objectstack/spec`'s `api/export.zod.ts`). The job is not stamped reverted and stays `undoable`, and undoing it again retries only those rows. The PR's pins (`packages/rest/src/import-undo-controls.test.ts`) drive this.

## What the console does with it

- `@objectstack/client`'s `data.undoImportJob` returns the body unchanged. `unwrapResponse` (`packages/client/src/index.ts`, about `:7406`) unwraps only an envelope that has `data`, and throws on no `success: false`.
- objectui `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx` `useImportJobUndo` (about `:1088`, at objectui `main`) runs `await ds.undoImportJob(jobId); notifyDataChanged(...)`. It never reads the answer, and `onError` fires only on a throw.
- So a partial undo shows nothing. The refreshed list still offers Undo on the job, with no reason and no per-row refusal text. Before objectstack-ai/objectstack#24380 every undo answered `success: true`, so this branch was unreachable.

## What done looks like

When the answer has `success: false`, the wizard says how many rows stayed unreverted and shows each `failures[].error`. Those are the app's own refusal sentences, for example a hook's. It also says that undoing again retries only those rows. A full undo is unchanged. A test drives a partial answer.

## Why it waits on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24380

The answer shape lands with PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24431. Until then, the server never answers `success: false`.

## Dedupe

- objectstack `search_issues` "Import Wizard undo import job result failures ignored partial undo no message": objectstack-ai/objectstack#24124 (closed, a QA run) and objectstack-ai/objectstack#3549 (closed, preserveAudit).
- objectui `search_issues` "ImportWizard useImportJobUndo undoImportJob answer": objectstack-ai/objectui#11650 (closed, cancel reporting).
- None is this defect. The control query reached the undo subject (objectstack-ai/objectstack#3549).
- Dedupe words: ImportWizard undo partial failures no message; undoImportJob success false ignored; import undo failures UI.
